title: Add 'athena review' to record class labels; show unreviewed in status
summary: Add `athena review <introspection-id>` that prints the introspection (what happened, class, cause, prevention, Jev's shadow answer) and, in the same call, commits an `athena.class-label/1` record with the person's verdict: class right, another existing class, or a new class (a new `athena.failure-class/1` record), plus an optional one-line note. `athena status` gains an unreviewed-introspection count. The introspection record is never touched.

defaults_applied.how: All new code is Rust in the existing crates.
New module and CLI behavior have passing tests using temporary-directory fixture records; clippy clean.
Behavior criteria are checked by running cargo test, clippy and fmt --check.
One focused change: the review command, one optional record field, one status count.
README, CHANGELOG and design docs updated for an outside reader.
The cause is that no command writes class-label records; the fix adds the writer instead of seeding fixtures.
The flag design, the note field and the unreviewed definition were recovered from labeled.rs, records.rs and status.rs, not asked.
Reuses existing record writing (`commit_records`), `RecordId` and the records parser. No new crates.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: One-step means flags, not prompts: `athena review <id> --right`, `--class <class-id>`, or `--new-class <name> --description <line>`, with optional `--note <line>` and `--json`. The record is shown, then the verdict is committed in the same call. Exactly one verdict flag is required.
`ClassLabel` has no note field, so add an optional `note: Option<String>` (serde default, skipped when absent) to `athena.class-label/1`. Old records still parse. The note must be a single line.
`--right` copies the introspection's own failure_class into the label. If the introspection has no class, `--right` is refused with a hint to use `--class` or `--new-class`.
A new class is written as a `FailureClass` record (status proposed, proposed_by = the introspection id) in the same commit as the label.

`labeled_by` is `person`. Reviewing an already-reviewed introspection adds a newer label, which the existing 'newest wins' rule in labeled::build already handles. The command prints a notice that it replaces the earlier label.
Unreviewed = introspections with no class-label record, the same rule as `labeled::build` (`Exclusions.unreviewed`). The status count reuses one shared helper, not a second definition.
An unknown or ambiguous introspection id, or a class id not in the registry, is an error with nothing written.
Writes go through `commit_records`, as other commands do. The `is_repeat` question is not asked.

acceptance_criteria.text: Run `cargo test`: tests using fixture records in a temporary directory show that after `review` with each verdict (right, existing class, new class, with and without a note) a class-label record exists with the expected class, note and labeled_by person, and the introspection file is byte-identical.
Run `cargo test`: a test shows that after a review `labeled::build` no longer counts the introspection as unreviewed (`unreviewed` drops by one).

Run `cargo test`: a test shows `athena status` (StatusView and its display) reports the number of unreviewed introspections and that the count falls after a review. When the count is above zero, `next` hints at `athena review`.
Run `cargo test`: tests show errors write nothing: unknown introspection id, unknown class id, no verdict flag, two verdict flags, `--right` on an introspection with no class, and a multi-line note.
`cargo clippy` (workspace, all targets) is clean and `cargo fmt --check` passes.

`ClassLabel` in crates/athena-data/src/records.rs has an optional `note` field that is absent from the JSON when None. A round-trip test covers both with and without a note, and the existing label test still passes.
The review output shows what happened, class (name and id), cause, prevention, and Jev's shadow class choice and probabilities, or says Jev was not asked or failed.

README.md's command table lists `athena review` and notes the status count. CHANGELOG.md has an entry. The docs that describe `athena.class-label/1` (docs/design/defaults-loop.md section 10.2) mention the note and that the build now writes these records.

out_of_scope: Prompting interactively or asking the is-repeat question.
Editing, deleting or re-committing any introspection record.
Changing score-jev's scoring, split or verdict.
Reviewing in bulk, a separate command that lists unreviewed ids, or auto-labeling with a stronger model.
Governance files (athena.toml, defaults.toml, CI, lint config).
departures: The change spans three crates, adds a record field and a new command with several error paths, so cost and time sit above the reference. The flag design is an assumption, which lowers acceptance slightly.
